messages:
Mira Shah: Quick sprint / request — we need a tiny customer-facing 'signal sampler' preflight for three renewal-risk accounts. Goal: single-screen form they can fill, 3 runnable checks (cache header, batch latency loop, stream smoke), PromQL anchors we can ask for, and a short mapping of signals -> AM next-step. Keep it copy-paste friendly for AMs (one paragraph they can paste into an email).

Omar Haddad: Love 'signal sampler'. Make the form include a config fingerprint (sha256 of their runtime JSON) so SRE can match exact settings. Also include an example of what a returned grafana screenshot should contain (time range + legend).

Lily Tran: Suggested thresholds (one-liners we can show inline): cache_hit < 30% -> optimization; p95 > 500ms -> ops triage; error_rate > 1% -> escalate. Recommend streaming for flows where median > 250ms. For UI flows keep batch_size 1-4.

Mira Shah: Add PromQL anchors so AMs can ask for exact charts rather than screenshots with no context. Also include exact curl snippets for the customer to run so we can reproduce quickly.

ops_bot: Tip: use `/autofill-metrics <acct>` to populate cache_hit, p95 and error_rate into the form automatically. I will also create a tracking ticket when the filled form is returned.

Omar Haddad: Pasteable customer form (single paragraph blocks so AMs can paste into an email):
---
SIGNAL SAMPLER PRE-FLIGHT (please complete before call)
- Account name:
- Eng contact (name / email):
- Affected endpoint(s):
- Cache strategy (prefix / response / shared KV):
- Cache TTL(s) observed (s):
- Cache hit % (7d):
- batch_size (min / max):
- streaming enabled? (y / n):
- p95 latency (24h):
- error rate (24h):
- recent config changes (14d):
- config fingerprint (sha256 of runtime JSON):
- top 3 flows to test:
---

Lily Tran: Runnable checks for engs to paste (one-liners, exact commands):
1) Cache header check: `curl -I -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate | grep -i x-cache`
2) Streaming smoke test: `curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Prefer: streaming=1" -d '{"input":"health-check","stream":true}' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate | sed -n '1,6p'`
3) Simple p95 loop (bash): `for i in {1..12}; do time curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate; done`

Mira Shah: PromQL anchors for AMs to request (copy/paste):
- Cache hit (7d): `sum(rate(cache_hits_total[7d])) / sum(rate(cache_requests_total[7d])) * 100`
- p95 latency (24h): `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[24h])) by (le))`
- Error rate (24h): `sum(rate(errors_total[24h])) / sum(rate(requests_total[24h])) * 100`
Include the time range (UTC) and legend order: request, servicer, cache.

Omar Haddad: Small 'what to change now' cheat sheet we can include as checkboxes (one-liners):
- Increase cache_ttl to 1800-3600s for stable prompts
- Convert repetitive prompts to prefix caching
- Reduce batch_size to 1-4 for interactive UI flows
- Enable streaming for median >250ms responses
- For sudden spikes, prefer warm-pools/autoscale burst over very large batch_size

Devon Price: Add a short note on 'screenshots we accept' so AMs stop sending tiny cropped images: ask customers to export PNG with 1) full time range (last 24h), 2) metric name in title, 3) legend visible, 4) raw query copied underneath. That speeds triage.

Mira Shah: Great. Omar — can you assemble a one-page PDF and a plain-text email snippet (the form + the three commands + PromQL anchors)? Add a small repo link to node/python smoke tests and a tiny script to compute the config-fingerprint. Target EOD. I'll route to AMs once it's live.

ops_bot: Created ticket CS-SS-7204 (signal-sampler) assigned to Omar Haddad. Use `/return-form CS-SS-7204` when the customer returns the filled form to auto-create a follow-up.

Omar Haddad: I'll draft and post here in ~2.5 hours. Will include the fingerprint script and sample graphs (cache_hit timeseries + p95).

Lily Tran: I'll add a one-line AM playbook mapping on the PDF (signal -> immediate AM step).

Mira Shah: Thanks team — this will reduce back-and-forth and give AMs concrete, reproducible asks for renewal-risk customers. :white_check_mark:
